caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular textile swatch with an intricate geometric pattern. The pattern consists of interlocking square and rectangular shapes arranged symmetrically within the textile, forming a repeating motif. The colors used in the drawing include muted shades of brown, olive green, and off-white. The central area features a concentration of brown squares, bordered by olive green and off-white shapes that create a grid-like effect. Surrounding this central section, the outer areas repeat similar shapes and colors, maintaining the overall symmetry of the design. The texture is represented with visible lines and crosshatching that simulate the woven quality of the fabric. The textile sample is centered on an off-white background, with ample empty space around it, and there is a handwritten signature visible just below the textile swatch on the right side.
title: Coverlet Detail
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
